data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'brietta', meaning 'bright, shining one'. This name was popular in the Middle Ages and has since been used in various forms in literature and history. The name Brietta carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Brietta usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Brietta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brietta total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Among them is Queen Guinevere's handmaiden, Breton told in Sir Thomas Malory's Le Morte d'Arthur.
